entities.name: Chingünjav
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Chingünjav, also known as Commander Chingünjav, was the Khalkha prince ruler of the Khotogoids and one of the two major leaders of the 1756-57 rebellion in Outer Mongolia. Although his rebellion failed, he is nowadays often hailed as a fighter for Outer Mongolia's independence from the Manchu-led Qing dynasty of China.
